entries.description: Top-level course shell; wraps LessonkitProvider and emits course lifecycle telemetry.

props.name: title
props.description: Course title shown in the h1.

props.name: courseId
props.description: Stable course identifier for telemetry and packaging.

props.name: config
props.description: Runtime config (tracking, xAPI, session, lxpack bridge). courseId is merged from props.

a11y.keyboard: No block-specific keyboard behavior; focus flows to child content.
a11y.notes: Renders h1 with course title. Wrap with ThemeProvider at app root for theming.

theming.stylingNotes: Inherits --lk-* CSS variables from ThemeProvider on document or scoped host.

entries.description: Lesson container; sets active lesson on mount and completes on unmount.

props.name: title
props.description: Lesson title shown in the h2.

props.name: lessonId
props.description: Stable lesson identifier for telemetry and packaging.

props.name: children
props.description: Scenario, Quiz, Reflection, and other blocks.

a11y.keyboard: No block-specific keyboard behavior; focus flows to child content.
a11y.notes: Renders h2 with lesson title. Only one Lesson should be mounted as active at a time in typical SPA layouts.

entries.description: Scenario or narrative content region for branching stories and situational context.

props.name: blockId
props.description: Optional stable block id for interaction telemetry URNs.

a11y.keyboard: No block-specific keyboard behavior; custom children may define their own.
a11y.notes: Use for situational framing. Pair with useTracking() for branching interactions.

theming.stylingNotes: Optional data-lk-block-id when blockId is set. Style via app CSS using --lk-* tokens.

entries.description: Reflection prompt with a textarea for learner free-text responses.

props.name: blockId
props.description: Optional stable block id for interaction telemetry URNs.

a11y.keyboard: Textarea is keyboard-focusable; standard text entry.
a11y.notes: When prompt is set, textarea uses aria-labelledby; otherwise aria-label='Reflection response'.

theming.stylingNotes: Optional data-lk-block-id when blockId is set. Style textarea via app CSS.

telemetry.manualTracking: useTracking().track('interaction', { kind, blockId, payload }) on submit or blur

entries.description: Single-question multiple-choice assessment with automatic answer and completion telemetry.

props.name: checkId
props.description: Stable check identifier for telemetry and LXPack assessments.

props.name: answer
props.description: Correct choice value (must match one choice).

a11y.keyboard: Radio group navigable with arrow keys; one choice per question.
a11y.liveRegions: role='status' aria-live='polite' for Correct / Try again feedback.
a11y.notes: Fieldset with visually hidden legend. KnowledgeCheck is an alias that renders Quiz with identical behavior.

theming.stylingNotes: data-lk-check-id set from checkId. Style labels and feedback via app CSS.

entries.description: Displays count of completed lessons from runtime progress state.

theming.stylingNotes: Inherits --lk-* CSS variables; style via app CSS.
